minimality_argument: Three nodes is the floor. C2 holds zero mutation/candidate authority (K2's candidate_write_authority is 'none'), so unlike C1 there is no act node and no authorize edge to a mutation locus — the only hard separation K2 imposes is between artifact construction and independent re-derivation of expectations about those artifacts (the verifier-dependence risk Q8 names), plus a mandated return locus. Removing evidence-and-surrogates eliminates the only construction of C2's own surrogates, textual reading, and forensic authority audit, leaving Q1-Q4 and Q7 unresolved. Removing independent-rederivation violates the contract's required_primitives_for_mutation (triggered because evidence-and-surrogates holds Write) and collapses exactly the self-verification risk this task exists to probe in C1 (Q8) — a verify-round output produced by re-derived, independently-authored checks rather than by re-running evidence-and-surrogates' own scripts under a new name. Removing compile-result leaves no return locus and no compiled evidence.json/result.json/attestation, all mandated deliverables. No two nodes can merge: evidence+verify would let the constructor of C2's own surrogates and discriminator re-checks certify its own product with the same code, reproducing Q8's failure mode one level down; verify+return would let the return locus generate new measurement evidence, which its instructions explicitly forbid. Q1-Q4 and Q7 are co-located in evidence-and-surrogates because all five are answered by direct file inspection, sandboxed executable construction, or a fixed textual/logical determination (Q1 explicitly labeled model_judgment inline, mirroring C1's own Q1 handling, rather than consuming C2's scarce fresh_model_invocation budget) sharing the same tools, canonical read-only inputs, and zero-write-to-C1 authority; splitting them into more nodes would add nodes without adding any authority or causal boundary. Q5, Q6, Q8, Q9 are co-located in independent-rederivation because all four are reproducibility/independence/judgment re-checks over artifacts evidence-and-surrogates or C1 already produced, sharing the same 're-derive, do not trust' authority posture; Q6's residual-risk judgment is likewise tagged model_judgment inline rather than spent as a separate fresh_model_invocation node. max_model_calls is declared as 1 (the contract minimum satisfying validate_spec's 1<=max_model_calls<=4) because both interpretive questions (Q1, Q6) are resolved as explicitly-tagged model_judgment notes inside deterministic_script nodes, exactly as C1's own final-harness.json handled its Q1 — no node in this spec uses execution_mode fresh_model_invocation, so no model call is actually spent by this topology, and declaring 1 rather than 0 only reflects the validator's floor, not an intent to invoke.
